digest.component_or_area: bridge fsck command and integrity audit
propositions: Retire phantom SYNC output cells (orphaned, duplicates, stale) from bridge fsck structured output and human report, updating all consumers including CLI, schema, MCP model, and tests
Replace SYNC-dependent scan with ref-based two-stage unknown-event-type detection using git grep on refs/heads/tickets without requiring a checkout
Add offline store_integrity audit that validates forward and reverse binding index agreement, reporting six specific integrity kinds for inconsistencies
Define Git failure semantics so missing ref, unavailable Git, malformed output, or grep exit >=2 raise RebarError(returncode=2) and CLI exit 2, while unknown-type findings remain informational
Ensure store_integrity findings make CLI exit 1, preserve informational exit semantics for unknown_event_types and binding_drift, and require no Jira client or network access
